title: Three DHHL wells on Hawaiian Home Lands
summary: A bill would approve an agreement for three Department of Hawaiian Home Lands (DHHL) wells, a storage tank and a pipeline to the county system, which DHHL said could produce about 1.728 million gallons a day for its beneficiaries; a councilmember asked why the county gets no water share. The Water and Infrastructure Committee amended the agreement to remove the fixed gallon figure, and the full Council later approved the committee report 9 to 0.

timeline.text: The Council approved the water wells report nine to zero.
A committee report advanced a bill for three water wells on Hawaiian Homelands land.
A councilmember asked for language letting credits be adjusted if the wells produce more or less than estimated.

timeline.text: Department of Hawaiian Home Lands (DHHL) said the wells provide water for its projects without straining the current county system.

timeline.body: County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
